validation.coverage: Legacy and LevelDB; known paths, rename/ancestor rename, hardlinks, final symlink rejection, ancestor symlink retarget/cycle/type change, unlink/path reuse, World and revision identity, reused World names, 4100 Worlds exceeding the 4096-hint budget, GC and reopen.

seeded_lookup_probe.scope: One sequential Release pair on copies of the same 66000-entry owned fixture. stat seeds the hint before timing ten lookups plus identity checks. Only committed sequence is compared; background I/O counters may change during reads.

limits: no FSEvents, recursive watch, revoke or revision replay qualification

Hints are non-authoritative, mutex-serialized and scoped by view kind/name and inode ID. Every use resolves the current path without final-symlink following and checks identity. Stale, absent or evicted hints fall back to traversal.

At most 4096 FIFO hints per Container; pathname bytes retain the existing 4096-byte bound. No object roots or GC pins, no storage/RPC/format changes, and no persistent index or constant-time cold-search guarantee.

The native append harness originally put child HOME/TMPDIR on the mount and exceeded 15 s. The script was corrected to isolate interpreter/xcrun startup caches on the host without raising deadlines. The final large-repository result uses BOTH that harness fix and this daemon; do not attribute the entire pass to inode hints alone.

Native acceptance covers the listed vnode operations amid 66000 preexisting empty files, on private single-user macOS 27.2.1 arm64. This is not universal latency, FSEvents, recursive watch, full POSIX/APFS or power-loss qualification.

watchdog_integration_2026_11_13.regression: Directory hint via a 3864-byte ancestor-symlink alias plus a 250-byte child exceeded the 4096-byte path bound despite a short physical path. New inode RPC create and lookup tests reseed that alias before each operation.
watchdog_integration_2026_11_13.fix: Directory hints traversing any symlink fall back to the physical directory traversal; file hint behavior and path bounds remain unchanged.
watchdog_integration_2026_11_13.environment: macOS 27.2 SDK, Apple Clang, Release WFS_FSKIT=ON; disposable git-archive sources without .git, deny-default sandbox, no host home/credentials/keychain access; loopback-only test transport.
watchdog_integration_2026_11_13.native_evidence_scope: Earlier native evidence above remains historical and pinned to its original runtime; this entry records new integrated CTest/callback validation, not a new signed native mount.
